must_record: The general partner or manager of each fund, with the period it manages
Each fund's vintage year, strategy, reporting currency, domicile, target size, final close date and investment period end
must_answer: Which general partner manages fund F as at a date?
Which funds does general partner G manage?
Which funds have a given vintage year and strategy?
must_prevent: A fund having two managers at the same time
A fund strategy outside the agreed list

must_record: What each legal entity is for in the structure
Each legal entity's identifiers, including its legal entity identifier, with the period each is valid
must_answer: Which vehicles in the structure are tax blockers?
What is the legal entity identifier of entity E?
must_prevent: A vehicle purpose outside the agreed list

must_record: Which vehicles invest alongside each fund, the kind of each, and the period
must_answer: Which vehicles invest alongside fund F?
must_prevent: A kind of side-by-side vehicle outside the agreed list

must_record: Each investor's commitment to each fund: amount, type, status, start and end
must_answer: What is limited partner L's commitment to fund F as at a date?
Who are the limited partners in fund F?
What is the general partner's own commitment to fund F?
must_prevent: A limited partner being limited to one fund or a fund to one limited partner
A commitment type outside the agreed list

must_record: Each capital call and distribution: type, date, currency
The amount each limited partner or other party paid or received, split by purpose
must_answer: How much did limited partner L pay in call C and for what purposes?
What was distributed to limited partner L in a year and of what kind?
What is limited partner L's unfunded commitment to fund F as at a date?
must_prevent: A call or distribution amount left blank
A purpose outside the agreed list
A party recorded without saying whether it paid or received

must_record: The stake each investor holds in each investee: economic share, voting share, control type, and the period
must_answer: What share of portfolio company P does each holder own as at a date?
Through which vehicles does fund F hold portfolio company P?
What does the whole sponsor hold in portfolio company P, looking through the chain?
Which funds hold the same portfolio company, and in what shares?
must_prevent: A stake with no share recorded
A control type outside the agreed list
A vehicle or investor being limited to a single holder or stake

must_record: Each acquisition, follow-on, partial exit, full exit and continuation transfer: type, date, currency
The instrument involved and its issuer
The amount and the number of units paid or received by each party
must_answer: What did fund F pay for portfolio company P and when?
Which funds took part in the follow-on investment and for how much each?
What were the proceeds of a partial exit, and who received them?
How many units of instrument I does fund F hold as at a date?
Which transfer moved portfolio company P from fund F to a continuation vehicle?
must_prevent: A single transaction covering two different instruments
A transaction type outside the agreed list

must_record: The fair value per unit of an instrument as at a date, its price type and its fair value hierarchy level
The value of a fund or portfolio company as at a date, on a named measure of value
must_answer: What was the fair value per unit of instrument I as at a date, and at which hierarchy level?
What was fund F's net asset value as at a date?
What was portfolio company P's enterprise value as at a date?
What is the fair value of fund F's holding in portfolio company P as at a date?
must_prevent: A hierarchy level outside the three allowed
A valuation with no measure, or a measure outside the agreed list
